verdicts.reason: Both use the same skyscraper stack. In both, the headline breaks one word per line, the legal text is set almost as large as the '25% off' subhead, the CTA is jammed between the subhead and the legal text, and the SOLSTICE logo is tiny. In B, the rotated 'Longest Day Sale' banner and the CTA pill run almost edge to edge with no side margin, and the decorative circle crowds the phone. A keeps clean margins around the banner and the button, so A is slightly better.
